segments.title: 第104章 喜歡
segments.content:
"Those in favor of Xu Youyu being elected as club president, please raise your hands."

"Alright, next, those who support Qin Yawei, please raise your hands."

"In that case, from now on, the position of president of the Literature Club will be held by student Xu Youyu."

Amidst a round of applause, Xu Youyu went on stage to share some of his thoughts.

Qin Yawei, on the other hand, returned to her seat with a gloomy expression, clearly not in a good mood.

Li Luo was also one of those applauding, until Xu Youyu's final announcement that Ying Chanxi from Class 1 of the first years, and Li Luo from Class 8 of the first years, would serve as vice presidents for the coming year. At that, Li Luo froze.

"Wait... why am I the vice president?"

After the evening self-study session ended, walking on the road home, Li Luo asked Xu Youyu with a speechless expression.

"Didn't I promise you?" Xu Youyu gave Li Luo a surprised look. "When I first invited you to the Literature Club, didn't I say it? Once I become president, you'll be the vice president."

"...I thought you were joking with me."

"Ha, what a joke! When have I ever not been a man of my word? How could I break my promise?"

"Heh." Li Luo looked at this guy who promised his readers extra chapters in *The Literary Age* but never delivered in the end, and gave a cold laugh.

Then, Li Luo asked again, "Don't the vice presidents need to be voted for? Didn't you all have to vote just now?"

"The voting was something Duan Qintian came up with." Xu Youyu waved his hand. "Every president has their own way of selecting people, entirely based on their own preference. The club itself has no written rules on how to choose. In previous years, the president always appointed them directly."

"You're turning back the clock of history, you know," Li Luo criticized harshly.

"And you're blaming me?" Xu Youyu shot him a sideways glance. "Who was it that didn't want to write the monthly manuscript?"

"What does that have to do with being vice president?"

"Because the vice president is the one responsible for collecting manuscripts every month." Xu Youyu kindly enlightened him. "If you don't want to write, and I don't say anything, and you don't say anything, then no one will ever know. Teacher Kong isn't going to check on this specifically."

"So that's how it is... By the way, which one is the Teacher Kong in charge of the Literature Club? I still haven't even met him."

"...He's your class's homeroom teacher." Xu Youyu looked completely speechless. "But the teachers in charge of interest-based clubs are usually just there in name. Only the competition-based clubs have teachers who get involved in management."

"Damn it! Old Kong never even told me about this."

"Well, now you know." Xu Youyu said with a grin. "From now on, I'll be counting on you and Xixi. Of course, Xixi is still the vice president of the student council and is usually pretty busy, so the work of collecting manuscripts for the Literature Club will mainly be up to you."

Li Luo: "...So you call it vice president, but it's actually just a coolie?"

"Don't you have a good memory?" Xu Youyu said. "I heard from Xixi that you memorized the names of all your classmates just by looking once at the start of the semester. So, you're the most suitable person for chasing up manuscripts."

"..." Li Luo's face darkened, not knowing what to say.

If anyone found out that his memory palace was being used for this kind of thing, he would probably be laughed at by all the other transmigrators.

Meanwhile, in the classroom, Yan Zhusheng packed her schoolbag after the third evening self-study session, went downstairs alone, and walked toward the dormitory.

The dormitory area of Fuyi High School was across the road from the school gate.

Under the watch of the school security guard, Yan Zhusheng successfully crossed the road and entered the dormitory area, glancing at the supermarket downstairs on the way back to her dorm.

After tilting her head and thinking carefully for a moment, Yan Zhusheng followed the crowd into the supermarket, bought a large pile of snacks, and returned to her dorm carrying the plastic bag.

At this time, her other roommates had already returned.

Some were showering, some were already lying in bed, and others were secretly playing on their phones or chatting.

Yan Zhusheng placed the plastic bag on her bed, then took out a few bags of snacks and handed them one by one to her dorm mates.

"Is this for me?" Li Luo's deskmate-in-front, Zhu Huiyan, was taken aback, a little surprised that Yan Zhusheng had suddenly handed her a bag of snacks.

Yan Zhusheng nodded, then distributed one bag to everyone else, including the one who was showering, placing the snack on her bed.

A strange silence fell over the dorm room.

But Yan Zhusheng just quietly put the remaining snacks into her schoolbag and went to take a shower.

The moment Yan Zhusheng entered the bathroom, the dorm room burst into chatter.

"What's up with her? Suddenly giving out snacks."

"Is that a bad thing? It's nice to get free snacks."

"Does she think she can buy me off with a bag of snacks? I was so mad about what happened during the military training."

"And she doesn't usually hang out with girls."

"She's with the class president all day. I think that's pretty suspicious."

"Don't you guys know? She and Li Luo have been together for a while now."

"For real? How come I haven't heard about it?"

"If you don't believe me, ask Zhu Huiyan. She secretly told me before."

"Hey, I told you not to tell anyone else! You're really something..."

"Since we're already on the topic, why hide it? Spill it, spill it."

"It's just... it's just... you guys don't know, during the lunch break, the two of them..."

"Now that you mention it, I heard about something too. You guys know about the rock band club? Li Luo wasn't even a member before, but later..."

"Hahaha, no wonder. I knew it. Being pretty really lets you do whatever you want. I'm so jealous."

Eating the snacks from Yan Zhusheng, the dorm room chatted happily.

The water in the bathroom splashed noisily, acting as an accompaniment.

Yan Zhusheng leaned her back against the door and scratched her head, feeling that the method Li Luo had suggested didn't seem to be very effective.

The next day, after math class, Yan Zhusheng took out a bag of snacks from her schoolbag and handed it to Li Luo beside her.

"When did you buy this?" Li Luo took the bag of potato chips and opened it to try one.

"Last night," Yan Zhusheng said. "There's still a lot more."

"Here, you have some too." Li Luo held it out in front of Yan Zhusheng.

Yan Zhusheng lowered her head, reached out for a chip, and put it in her mouth.

Then she watched as Li Luo stood up, walked over to her deskmate-in-front, Xu Guangtao, and patted him on the shoulder. "Potato chips from Yan Zhusheng. Try some."

"Oh, oh, oh..." Xu Guangtao, flattered, took a chip from the bag, then turned to Yan Zhusheng and said, "Thanks, huh."

"Zhu Huiyan, want some?" Li Luo looked at Xu Guangtao's deskmate.

"Huh? I... um... I'm good." Zhu Huiyan shook her head.

"Class president, give me some," Zhu Yufei called out from the other side.

"These chips aren't mine." Li Luo turned around, offered the bag in that direction, then pulled it back in a very punchable way. "What are you supposed to say?"

"Yan Zhusheng, grant me a chip!" Zhang Guohuang answered first. Under Li Luo's satisfied nod, he successfully got a potato chip and raised his eyebrows at Zhu Yufei.

"Damn! You're so damn shameless." Zhu Yufei cursed with a laugh, then immediately turned and said, "Yan Zhusheng! We're colleagues, after all. A potato chip isn't too much to ask, right?"

Yan Zhusheng nodded.

So Li Luo smilingly passed the potato chips over and gave Zhu Yufei a piece.

"Xu Yinghuan, want some?" Li Luo looked at the girl in front who had turned her head, looking a bit greedy, and shook the bag of chips in his hand.

"Hehe, class president is the best." Xu Yinghuan came running over.

"What's it got to do with me? These are Yan Zhusheng's."

"Sheng-sheng," Xu Yinghuan said syrupy sweet to Yan Zhusheng, batting her sparkling eyes, "I've been a fan of yours for ten years, you know. I love listening to you sing."

Yan Zhusheng nodded.

Li Luo bestowed a potato chip.

Just then, Hua Xiuxiu came back from the restroom through the back door. As she passed by the aisle, she was stopped by Li Luo's potato chips.

"Yan Zhusheng's. Want one?"

"Oh." Hua Xiuxiu paused for a moment, then took a chip and said to Yan Zhusheng, "Thanks."

"Sister Yan, want one?" Li Luo then said to Shi Yanran next to him.

"Ah? Th-thank you." Shi Yanran didn't expect Li Luo to call out to her. Her small, chubby hand took a chip. After a moment's thought, she hurriedly took out a bag of fruit candies from her desk drawer. "Class president, do you want this?"

"Only for me?" Li Luo raised an eyebrow.

"No, no." Shi Yanran shook her head repeatedly, sharing them with Xu Yinghuan in the front seat, Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang in the back, and the other students around them.

Finally, she came to Yan Zhusheng.

"Thank you." Yan Zhusheng took the fruit candy, carefully unwrapped it, and placed it in her mouth.

A sweetness she had never tasted before instantly bloomed in her heart.

As for Li Luo, after walking around for a bit, the entire bag of potato chips was gone.

Li Luo tossed the empty bag into the trash can, sat back down as the class bell rang, clapped his hands, and said to Yan Zhusheng, "I'm only demonstrating this once, you know. From now on, you hand them out yourself. Don't just feed me alone."

Yan Zhusheng pursed her lips, her brow furrowing with a bit of distress. "It's a little hard."

"Then, did you like the feeling just now?"

"...I liked it."

(End of Chapter)
